subject: Replay & SLA: NeuralOps Webinar — Claiming plan + unclaimed account resolution
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: marketing_ops@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-07T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: NeuralOps webinar — replay, attendee tiers, and 48h SDR claim SLA

Team — quick post-mortem and ops for the NeuralOps webinar we ran this morning. Thanks to everyone who helped run the Q&A and the live demo. We have a ~930-attendee roll (CSV attached) with the following priority tiers I pulled from the registration data: 

- Tier A (VIP / high-value): 12 accounts — C-suite or paid trials; recommendation: 1:1 outreach within 24 hours.
- Tier B (engaged enterprise): ~85 accounts — high activity, company size >200; outreach within 48 hours.
- Tier C (SMB / nurture): remaining registrants — drip cadence via marketing automation.

Action items (please action by SLA below):
1) SDR claim SLA: claim Tier A/B accounts in HubSpot within 48 hours (deadline: 11/09 10:12 PT). Add owner and next-step on the company record.
2) Top 12 VIPs flagged in the CSV under column "priority" — Aditya, please take the top 5; Lauren, please take the next 4; Logan, take the remaining 3.
3) Unclaimed mid-tier (B) > If any of you see an unassigned account after 48h, flag it to me and marketing_ops for redistribution.
4) External replay distribution: we'll send a short note + replay link to registrants; partners may receive a package with the deck.

Replay & assets attached: attendee_list_20281107.csv (primary source of truth), neuralops-webinar-deck-v2.pdf. Also saving a Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NeuralOps/Webinar_Assets

Please reply with the accounts you claim in this thread so I can keep a live tracker.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Attach: attendee_list_20281107.csv (CSV), neuralops-webinar-deck-v2.pdf (PDF)
